name: Brightside data store space
description: Reports and reclaims the disk Brightside's data store takes. With no input, reports the store's size, whether compaction is asked for, and the originals earlier repairs kept beside it. compact: true asks for the store to be compacted the next time Brightside starts: only what the store no longer refers to is dropped, nothing in use is lost, and the space comes back then. compact: false withdraws the request. Nothing happens until Brightside next starts, and this operation never starts or stops it. removeKeptOriginals: true deletes the originals earlier repairs kept, which cannot be undone. Venue-operator only.

compact.description: true asks for compaction at the next start; false withdraws the request.

removeKeptOriginals.description: true deletes the originals earlier repairs kept beside the store. Cannot be undone.

storeBytes.description: The store file's size on disk.

compactAtNextStart.description: Whether the store is compacted the next time Brightside starts.

keptOriginals.description: The originals earlier repairs kept: name, bytes, and modified (ISO-8601).

removed.description: With removeKeptOriginals: the originals deleted, as in keptOriginals.
